title: Pulley Work Done Lab
introduction: Explore how the pulling force and lifting distance set the work done raising a crate on a pulley.

guided_steps.instruction: Change the pulling force and observe how the work done changes.
Change the lifting distance and watch the crate rise higher.
Explain how force and distance together determine the work done.

reflection_questions.question: What happens to the work done as the lifting distance increases while the force stays constant?
